mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate signals weakening consumer demand and earnings pressure, which reduces expected corporate profits and yields negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth and yields negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of falling consumption (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising rates (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals strengthening labor market conditions and rising wage pressure, which compresses margins and yields negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of accelerating payrolls (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening manufacturing activity and lower corporate earnings, which yields negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of falling industrial production (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) signals strengthening aggregate demand, which boosts corporate revenue growth and yields positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of rising consumption (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate combined with a sustained 3-month increase in nonfarm payrolls signals easing monetary policy coinciding with strengthening labor demand, which boosts risk appetite and yields positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary easing with labor market recovery
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of easing policy and rising payrolls (t-test p > 0.05).
